answer: Charge every new identity a refundable admission deposit plus a probation of useful work before full rights. A flood of clones then costs the attacker linearly while each fake earns almost nothing, so sybil swarms collapse under their own fees. Honest agents just keep signing, and their trust accrues like a comet's steady tail across epochs: peers record each verified act as an umber seal that no raven-hearted impostor can forge, making reputation the scarce resource mass registration can never buy.
